events.text:
T-148 is blocked: the cover logo still 404s on the live deck, and I didn't push the fix again because Adi's 2026-10-11 rule says agents never touch Usetantra repos. That rule came after the Orchestrator's 2026-10-10 approval, and the earlier fix was reverted under it.

- **Edit the slide sources, rebuild, push both decks:** not done. Pushing is now forbidden for agents. The fix is saved as two patches:
  - `workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/tantra-webinar-deck/main--b3def23f6b.patch`
  - `workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/webinar-deck/main--097f6bd6a5.patch`
- **Every logo URL returns 200:** not met. I checked the live deck this run: lines 83 and 348 still use `url('tantra-logo.png')`, which returns 404. `uploads/tantra-logo.png` returns 200.
- **Cover screenshot shows the Tantra mark:** not met. The cover can't show the mark until the patch is applied.
- **review_hub.py has no 404 note:** done. Grep shows the webinar-deck element (now line 279) has no note. I left it off because T-148 now tracks the defect.
- **AUDIT.md H038:** the "fixed" entry was wrong after the revert, so I changed it to "open again 2026-10-11" and pointed it at the two patches. AUDIT.md is not under git, so there was nothing to commit.
- **Task state:** set to blocked, and I reassigned it to Bharath with reviewers Bhaskar and Bharath. The note F-3c98063d is acknowledged.

To unblock it, someone with Usetantra repo access (Bharath) runs `git am` with each patch in its repo (`tantra-webinar-deck` and `webinar-deck`), then pushes main.
